title: On the existence of coupled extremal Kähler metrics on ruled surfaces
summary: We investigate the existence conditions for coupled extremal Kähler metrics on minimal ruled surfaces over a genus 2 Riemann surface. Using the Calabi ansatz to reduce the coupled extremal equations to ordinary differential equations, we prove that a pair of coupled extremal metrics exists for normalized Kähler classes $Ω_a$ and $Ω_b$ if and only if their parameters $(a, b)$ belong to an explicitly defined open region $\mathcal{S}_{\mathrm{ext}}$ in the positive real quadrant.
